C、Python、JS 的差异根源: Why C, Python and JavaScript differ
变量其实是个名字: A variable can be a name
以 Python 为例，变量名绑定到对象；重新赋值会改变绑定，不是修改原对象。: In Python, a name binds to an object. Reassignment changes the binding, not the original object.
Python 中 x = 42，把名字 x 绑定到表示整数 42 的对象。: Python's x = 42 binds the name x to an integer object representing 42.
再写 x = 43，x 改为绑定到 43，并没有把整数对象 42 改掉。: x = 43 rebinds x to 43; it does not change the integer object 42.
名字重新绑定，不代表原对象马上消失；不要把这个模型套到所有语言。: Rebinding need not immediately destroy the old object. Other languages have different models.
在 Python 中，x = 42 之后又执行 x = 43，发生了什么？: In Python, what happens when x = 43 follows x = 42?
x 改为指向新的值 43: x is rebound to the new value 43
这是 Python 名字 x 的重新绑定，原整数对象 42 没被修改。对象不可达: The name x is rebound; the original integer object 42 is unchanged. Unreachable objects may be collected, but not necessarily immediately. Assignment counts do not determine allocation counts.
在 Python 中，b = a 让两个名字绑定到同一个对象，并不复制对象内容。: In Python, b = a binds two names to one object without copying its contents.
无论绑定的是整数还是列表，Python 的简单名字赋值都不复制对象内容。: Simple name assignment copies no object contents, whether the object is an integer or a list.
a = [1,2]; b = a 后，两个名字引用同一个可变列表。: After a = [1,2]; b = a, both names refer to the same mutable list.
通过 b 追加元素，a 也能看到；但把 b 重新绑定到别的列表，不会改 a。: Appending through b is visible through a; rebinding b to another list does not change a.
Python 里 a = [1,2]; b = a; b.append(3) 之: In Python, after a = [1,2]; b = a; b.append(3), what is a?
b.append(3) 修改共享列表，所以 a 看到 [1,2,3]；这与执行: b.append(3) mutates the shared list, so a sees [1,2,3]. This differs from rebinding with b = [3]. A reference describes an object relationship, not necessarily a visible physical address.
类型约束值的范围、允许的操作及其含义；不能只把类型理解为固定大小的内存盒子。: Types constrain values, operations and their meanings; they are more than fixed-size memory boxes.
Java int 为32位；Python int 精度可增长，受内存限制。: Java int is 32-bit; Python int can grow in precision, limited by memory.
类型影响可用操作：例如 Python 内置字符串支持拼接，但不支持直接相减。: Types affect operations: Python strings support concatenation but not direct subtraction.
静态检查可在运行前发现部分类型错误；动态类型的操作检查主要发生在运行时。: Static checks find some type errors before execution; dynamic checks primarily occur at runtime.
静态类型语言和动态类型语言的核心区别是？: What is the core difference between static and dynamic typing?
一个有类型，一个没有: One has types; the other does not
主要在运行前还是运行时检查类型约束: Whether type constraints are mainly checked before or during execution
两者都有类型。静态检查能在运行前发现部分不合法操作，但不保证找出所有错误，也不排: Both have types. Static checks detect some invalid operations early, not every error, and do not rule out runtime checks. Typing alone does not determine speed.
能不能原地改: Can the object change in place?
Python 列表可原地修改，整数和字符串不可；重新绑定不等于修改对象。: Python lists can be mutated; integers and strings cannot. Rebinding is not mutation.
可变对象的内容可以改变，对象身份不变；身份不等于所有实现中的物理地址。: Mutable contents can change while identity stays the same; identity is not always a physical address.
不可变对象本身不被改写；计算结果可能使用新对象，也可能复用已有对象。: Immutable objects do not change; results may use new or existing objects.
若反复拼接时每轮都复制已有内容，累计复制量可能很大；具体实现可能优化。: If each concatenation copies prior contents, repeated copying can grow expensive; implementations may optimize it.
假设循环每轮拼接都创建结果并复制已有内容，为什么可能很慢？: Why can a loop be slow if every concatenation creates a result and copies all prior contents?
字符串太长放不下: The string is too long to fit
反复复制不断增长的已有内容: It repeatedly copies a growing amount of content
按题设，每轮追加固定长度片段时，复制量累加可呈平方级增长。这是给定复制模型的分析: Under this model, appending fixed-size fragments can make total copying grow quadratically. This is an analysis of the stated copying behavior, not every language or optimization. For bulk Python concatenation, consider join.
以 JavaScript 为例：作用域决定名字的可见范围。: In JavaScript, scope determines where names are visible.
从内向外查找名字；内层同名绑定会遮蔽外层。: Lookup moves outward; an inner binding shadows an outer one with the same name.
外部不能直接按名字访问函数内的局部绑定。: Outside code cannot directly name a function's local binding.
普通同步调用返回后，栈帧退出；闭包可保留绑定。: A normal synchronous return removes the stack frame; closures can retain access to bindings.
JavaScript 普通同步函数正常调用时，它的调用栈帧通常何时退出调用栈？: When does a normal synchronous JavaScript function call's frame usually leave the call stack?
普通同步调用正常返回后，其栈帧退出调用栈；这不保证局部绑定或对象立即被回收。闭包: A normal synchronous return removes its frame, but does not guarantee immediate collection of bindings or objects. Closures may still access referenced bindings. Directly reading a missing JS name usually throws ReferenceError; calling that “undefined behavior” is inaccurate.
JS 的 let/const 有块作用域，不代表值立即销毁。: JavaScript let and const have block scope; leaving scope does not immediately destroy values.
这里的块指 JS 语句块，不是所有花括号。: Here, “block” means a JS statement block, not every pair of braces.
离开块后外部不能直接查找块内名字；闭包仍可引用。: Outside code cannot directly find block-local names, but closures may still reference them.
var 不受普通块限制，常落在函数或脚本、模块顶层。: var ignores ordinary block boundaries and often belongs to function, script or module scope.
JavaScript 中，用 let/const 缩小名字可见范围的主要理由是？: Why prefer let/const when narrowing the visibility of JavaScript names?
var 没有块级作用域，还允许重复声明: var lacks block scope and permits redeclaration
let 是新关键字所以更好: let is newer, so it must be better
在 JavaScript 普通语句块中，var 不创建块级绑定，并可在允许的范围: In ordinary JS statement blocks, var creates no block-local binding and allows redeclaration where permitted. let/const make visibility clearer. Loop closure results also depend on declaration placement and invocation timing; var does not always yield a wrong value.
函数会记住出生的地方: A function remembers its definition environment
闭包把函数与定义处的词法环境联系起来。: A closure connects a function to the lexical environment where it was defined.
JS 函数创建时关联定义处环境，不复制值快照。: Creating a JS function associates its environment; it does not copy a value snapshot.
外层返回后，可达闭包仍可访问所引用的绑定。: A reachable closure can access referenced bindings after the outer function returns.
读取哪个值还取决于绑定的变化和调用时机。: The observed value depends on binding changes and when the function is called.
JavaScript 闭包为什么能在外层函数返回后访问其引用的局部绑定？: Why can a JavaScript closure access referenced local bindings after an outer function returns?
因为函数持有对那个环境的引用: The function retains a reference to that environment
因为变量被挪到了全局: The variables moved to global scope
JS 函数对象关联定义处的词法环境；可达闭包仍能访问所引用的绑定，而不是自动复制: A JS function is associated with its definition environment. A reachable closure accesses bindings rather than automatically copying every value. Reads happen when called; bindings may change, and previously referenced objects need not live forever.
全局变量为什么危险: Why shared global state is risky
隐式共享的可变状态，让读写依赖更难追踪。: Implicitly shared mutable state makes read and write dependencies hard to track.
JS 全局绑定的可见范围受环境与同名遮蔽影响。: JS global visibility depends on the environment and shadowing.
多个位置修改共享状态，会增加排查与测试难度。: Updates from many locations make debugging and testing harder.
全局或闭包的引用可能延长对象存活，不保证永久占用。: Global or closure references may extend lifetimes, not necessarily forever.
大型项目里滥用全局变量最主要的代价是？: What is the main cost of overusing global variables in a large project?
状态来源不可控，难排查也难测试: Hard-to-control state that complicates debugging and testing
隐式共享的可变状态可能让模块产生隐藏耦合，使测试相互影响；显式传参、封装与重置可: Hidden shared state couples modules and can make tests affect each other. Explicit parameters, encapsulation and reset strategies help. Not every global constant or side effect is wrong; keep dependencies and updates understandable and controlled.
以C++对象指针为例：它可指向对象，图中用地址表示。: A C++ object pointer can point to an object, shown here using an address.
图中地址只是示例，不是物理内存布局保证。: The address is illustrative, not a physical memory layout guarantee.
p指向值为42的对象，图中地址是0x7ff4。: p points to the integer 42 at example address 0x7ff4.
通过有效指针解引用，才能访问它指向的对象。: Dereferencing a valid pointer accesses its target object.
图中C++指针p指向一个整数对象，它保存的是？: The C++ pointer p points to an integer object. What does it hold here?
在这个有效对象指针示例中，p表示目标对象的地址；*p访问目标。指针也可为空，不能: In this valid object-pointer example, p represents the target's address and *p accesses it. Pointers can also be null, so not every pointer is dereferenceable.
顺着地址找过去: Follow the pointer to its target
对有效的C++对象指针，*p访问目标，赋值可修改目标。: For a valid C++ object pointer, *p accesses the target; assignment can modify it.
图中p指向0x7ff4处的整数对象。: Here p points to an integer at 0x7ff4.
*p表示访问该对象，前提是类型、生命周期和边界允许。: *p accesses it only when type, lifetime and bounds permit.
*p = 10修改目标值，不会改掉p保存的指针值。: *p = 10 changes the target, not p's pointer value.
p有效指向一个可写的C++整数对象时，*p = 10修改谁？: If p validly points to a writable C++ integer, what does *p = 10 change?
p 指向的那块内存内容: The contents of the object p points to
这里*p是目标对象，赋值修改其值；p本身没有重新赋值。空指针或失效指针不满足题目: Here *p denotes the target object, so assignment changes its value without reassigning p. Null or invalid pointers do not meet the question's premise.
C++左值引用是别名；初始化后不能改绑，仍须注意寿命。: A C++ lvalue reference cannot be rebound after initialization; lifetime still matters.
以C++的int& r=x为例，r绑定到x。: In C++ int& r = x, r binds to x.
给r赋值是在修改x，不是把r改绑到另一个对象。: Assigning to r changes x; it does not bind r to a new object.
引用没有合法的空引用状态，但目标销毁后仍可能悬空。: There is no valid null-reference state, but a destroyed target can leave a dangling reference.
C++ 的引用和指针，最本质的区别是？: What is the key distinction between C++ references and pointers here?
引用必须绑定对象且不能改绑: A reference must bind to an object and cannot be rebound
以这里的C++左值引用为例，初始化后不能改绑；指针可以为空或改指别处。引用也可能: A C++ lvalue reference cannot be rebound after initialization; a pointer may be null or point elsewhere. References can dangle and do not automatically ensure lifetime safety.
空指针、未初始化指针和悬空指针要分清，误用不保证崩溃。: Distinguish null, uninitialized and dangling pointers. Misuse need not crash.
C++的nullptr表示空指针值，不代表一个可访问对象。: C++ nullptr represents a null pointer, not an accessible object.
对象寿命结束后，原来的指针或引用可能悬空。: Pointers and references can dangle after an object's lifetime ends.
把一个指针置空，不会修复其他仍指向旧对象的别名。: Nulling one pointer does not fix other aliases to the old object.
C++中继续解引用已释放对象的指针，会怎样？: What can happen when C++ dereferences a pointer to a freed object?
未定义行为，可能崩溃或破坏数据: Undefined behavior, possibly a crash or data corruption
释放对象不会自动清空所有指针。继续解引用可能产生未定义行为，既可能崩溃，也可能表: Freeing an object does not clear every pointer. Dereferencing afterward can cause undefined behavior: a crash, corruption or apparently normal execution. No particular symptom is guaranteed.
在连续存储模型中，数组可按下标直接定位元素。: In a contiguous layout, array indices directly locate elements.
这里用等大小元素连续存放的数组举例。: This example uses equally sized, contiguous elements.
地址可由起始位置、下标和元素大小计算。: The base, index and element size determine the address.
保持顺序地插入中间位置，通常需要移动后面的元素。: Inserting in the middle while preserving order usually moves later elements.
为什么数组按下标访问是 O(1)？: Why is indexed array access O(1)?
地址可以由起点和下标直接算出: The address is calculated from the base and index
在连续数组、元素访问成本固定的模型中，可由下标算出位置，不必从头遍历。这里讨论按: With contiguous elements and fixed access cost, an index computes the location without traversal. This describes access by index, not searching by value.
链表靠链接组织节点，已知位置时可局部修改连接。: Links organize nodes and allow local changes when the position is known.
节点用链接连接，不要求相邻存放。: Nodes need not be adjacent; links connect them.
已知插入位置和所需前驱时，接入节点不用搬动其他元素。: With the insertion position and needed predecessor known, other elements need not move.
按下标找第n个节点，通常需要沿链接遍历。: Finding the nth node usually requires traversal.
已备好新节点、不计分配成本时，单链表头部插入的时间复杂度是？: With a new node already allocated, what is the time complexity of inserting at a singly linked list's head?
只需让新节点指向旧头，再更新头指针。按下标寻找插入位置的遍历成本要另计；分配器和: Point the new node to the old head, then update the head pointer. Traversal to locate an indexed position is a separate cost; allocation and construction may also cost work.
哈希表用计算换查找: Hash tables compute where to look
哈希帮助定位候选位置，冲突时还需比较键。: Hashing locates candidate positions; collisions still require key comparisons.
先计算键的哈希值；计算本身也可能有成本。: First hash the key; computing the hash may itself cost work.
再按实现规则映射到桶或槽位，取模只是一个例子。: Map it to buckets or slots according to the implementation; modulo is one example.
不同键可能冲突，需按规则探测并比较键。: Different keys may collide, requiring probing and equality checks.
在负载因子受控、键操作成本固定时，哈希表平均O(1)查找还需要？: With controlled load and fixed-cost key operations, what else supports average O(1) hash lookup?
哈希函数能把键均匀分散: A hash function that distributes keys well
良好分布和受控负载能减少碰撞。查找通常还要比较键，最坏情况可能退化；长字符串的哈: Good distribution and controlled load reduce collisions. Key comparisons still occur; worst-case behavior can degrade. Hashing and comparing long strings are not free.
快慢取决于你最常做哪种操作，先数操作再选结构。: Performance depends on your common operations. Identify them before choosing a structure.
数组适合按下标访问和连续遍历，中间插删需考虑移动。: Arrays suit indexed access and sequential traversal; middle edits may require movement.
链表修改已知位置的链接方便，但查找位置可能昂贵。: Lists update known links easily, but locating positions may be expensive.
哈希适合按键查找；是否保留插入顺序取决于具体容器。: Hash tables suit key lookup; insertion-order guarantees depend on the container.
需要频繁按 key 查、且不关心顺序，优先选？: For frequent key lookup with no ordering requirement, what is a good first choice?
哈希表通常适合按键查找。有的哈希容器保留插入顺序；若需要按键排序或范围查询，应另: Hash tables typically suit key lookup. Some preserve insertion order; for sorted keys or range queries, choose a structure that supports those operations.
C的动态分配通常要管理释放；并非所有对象都要手动free。: C dynamic allocations usually need explicit release; not every object needs free.
malloc成功时返回分配区域的指针，失败时可返回空指针。: malloc returns allocated storage on success and may return null on failure.
动态资源用完后须按约定释放，自动存储期对象不这样管理。: Release dynamic resources as required; automatic objects have different lifetimes.
越界或释放后使用可能造成未定义行为，不保证立刻崩溃。: Out-of-bounds and use-after-free can cause undefined behavior, not necessarily an immediate crash.
持续malloc成功分配、丢失指针且从不free，可能造成什么？: What can repeated successful malloc calls cause if pointers are lost and free is never called?
内存泄漏，占用越来越多: A memory leak with growing resource use
这会泄漏动态分配的内存，持续发生可能耗尽资源。并非每个C变量都来自malloc，: This leaks dynamic allocations and may eventually exhaust resources. Not every C variable comes from malloc, and free must not be applied indiscriminately to all variables.
Python名字绑定对象，简单赋值不复制对象，回收时机依实现。: Python names bind to objects. Assignment does not copy them; collection timing depends on implementation.
Python中数字等值也是对象，名字可绑定到它们。: Numbers and other Python values are objects that names can reference.
简单名字赋值a=b让a绑定到b当前绑定的对象。: Simple assignment a = b binds a to the object currently bound to b.
不可达对象可能被回收，不应依赖立即回收。: Unreachable objects may be collected; do not rely on immediate collection.
Python 中 a = b 之后，修改 b 指向的可变对象，a 会看到变化吗？: After a = b in Python, will a observe a mutation of the mutable object b refers to?
不会，a 是独立副本: No; a is an independent copy
会，两者指向同一个对象: Yes; they refer to the same object
这里是两个简单名字绑定同一可变对象。修改该对象可由两者观察到；若只是重新绑定b，: Both simple names bind to the same mutable object, so both observe its mutation. Merely rebinding b does not automatically rebind a.
JS主线程与事件循环: JavaScript's Main Thread and Event Loop
浏览器主线程串行执行任务，Worker可在独立环境运行脚本。: A browser's main thread runs tasks serially; Workers run scripts in separate environments.
在这里的浏览器主线程中，同一时刻执行一个JS任务。: In this browser main-thread model, one JS task runs at a time.
网络等异步操作由宿主协调，完成后安排相应回调。: The host coordinates asynchronous work such as networking and schedules callbacks.
当前任务结束后处理微任务；长任务仍会影响交互和渲染。: Microtasks run after the current task; long tasks still delay input and rendering.
在 JS 主线程里写一个长循环，界面会怎样？: What happens to a browser UI during a long loop on the JavaScript main thread?
卡住，因为主线程被占满: It stalls because the main thread is busy
浏览器自动开新线程: The browser automatically creates another thread for it
浏览器拒绝执行: The browser refuses to execute it
长循环占用浏览器主线程，会延迟事件处理和主线程上的渲染工作。仅加async或Pr: A long loop delays event handling and main-thread rendering work. Adding async or a Promise does not automatically move computation off-thread. Consider splitting work into tasks or using a Worker.
选语言看的是要解决的问题，不是哪门更高级。: Choose a language for the problem, not a prestige ranking.
需要细致控制资源时，可评估C、C++或Rust及其工程代价。: For fine resource control, evaluate C, C++ or Rust and their engineering costs.
快速验证或数据处理可评估Python及现有库，性能需实测。: For prototyping or data work, evaluate Python and its libraries; measure performance.
浏览器交互常用JS，也可结合编译到JS的语言或WebAssembly。: Browser interaction commonly uses JS, sometimes with compiled-to-JS languages or WebAssembly.
选择编程语言时，最该优先考虑的是？: What should matter most when choosing a programming language?
要解决的问题与团队现状: The problem and the team's circumstances
生态、性能特征和团队熟悉度决定开发成本，脱离场景谈语言优劣没有意义。: Ecosystems, performance characteristics and team experience affect development cost. Comparing languages without a use case is not useful.
